description: The attacker claims the gateway 10.1.1.1 with a reply to 10.1.1.10 every 3s for a minute, answering no request. The gateway was not heard before (IDS started later), so there is no binding change. unsolicited_reply fires on the fifth (12s) and summarizes the rest; hosts resolving each other and 10.1.1.20's boot announcement do not count.
